resources.string: Each letter is shifted by its own key letter, like Vigenere with a key that never repeats. With a truly random key used only once, the ciphertext reveals nothing about the message.
Message letters: %1$d, key letters: %2$d. Never reuse a key.
Message letters: %1$d, key letters: %2$d. The key must be at least as long as the message.

Every message of the same length is possible: for any guess there is a key that turns this ciphertext into it.
